uutiset.t: Belief and bench help Northern Ireland scale new heights as promotion secured
uutiset.s: Manager Michael O'Neill hails the belief shown by his side after they come from behind against Hungary to earn the draw required for promotion to Nations League A.

uutiset.t: Bellamy convinced of Wales credentials despite defeat by Portugal
uutiset.s: Wales finished bottom of their Nations League group, but boss Craig Bellamy believes his team showed they belong in the top flight.

uutiset.t: Republic of Ireland talisman Parrott caps dream year with two more goals
uutiset.s: Republic of Ireland striker Troy Parrott reflects on a transformative 12 months for both club and country after scoring a double in the win against Kosovo.

uutiset.t: Humphries and Van Gerwen into Grand Slam knockouts
uutiset.s: Luke Humphries and Michael van Gerwen book their places in the last 16 of the Grand Slam of Darts with victories in their final group matches.

uutiset.t: Ruthless Zverev through to ATP Finals knockout stage
uutiset.s: World number one Alexander Zverev produces a serving masterclass to defeat Ben Shelton and qualify for the ATP Finals knockout stage with a match to spare.

uutiset.t: Liverpool lead Chelsea in Camara race - Wednesday's gossip
uutiset.s: Liverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and ex-Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.

uutiset.t: International Ice Hockey Federation website hacked after Russia banned from event
uutiset.s: The International Ice Hockey Federation's website was targeted in a cyber attack, seemingly in response to Canada's decision to ban Russia from the World Junior Hockey Championship.

uutiset.t: Highlights: Ten-man Portugal beat Wales to top group
uutiset.s: Watch the best of the action as Portugal beat Wales in the Nations League in Cardiff.

uutiset.t: Millwall open disciplinary proceedings against Baker
uutiset.s: Millwall are undertaking disciplinary proceedings against forward Benicio Baker, BBC Sport understands.

uutiset.t: Madrid-bound Gabriel posts farewell Man Utd message
